# decorated-room.txt — sealed room + func_detail decoration (hammer-optimisation-func-detail)
#
# Format: one `brush <name> [detail|blocker|illusionary]` line, then one
# `plane nx ny nz d` line per face (outward unit normal, plane Dot(n, p) == d,
# solid side Dot(n, p) <= d — the MapBrushFace / BspPlane convention).
# The six shell brushes are the sealed-room.txt room (interior void
# -128..128 x -128..128 x 0..128); the four flagged brushes are decoration
# inside the void (three stair treads + a trim beam). Built with these flags
# the room must have the same leaf count as the bare room; built structural
# the decoration must add visleaves.
brush floor
plane -1 0 0 144
plane 1 0 0 144
plane 0 -1 0 144
plane 0 1 0 144
plane 0 0 -1 16
plane 0 0 1 0
brush ceiling
plane -1 0 0 144
plane 1 0 0 144
plane 0 -1 0 144
plane 0 1 0 144
plane 0 0 -1 -128
plane 0 0 1 144
brush wall-x-neg
plane -1 0 0 144
plane 1 0 0 -128
plane 0 -1 0 144
plane 0 1 0 144
plane 0 0 -1 0
plane 0 0 1 128
brush wall-x-pos
plane -1 0 0 -128
plane 1 0 0 144
plane 0 -1 0 144
plane 0 1 0 144
plane 0 0 -1 0
plane 0 0 1 128
brush wall-y-neg
plane -1 0 0 128
plane 1 0 0 128
plane 0 -1 0 144
plane 0 1 0 -128
plane 0 0 -1 0
plane 0 0 1 128
brush wall-y-pos
plane -1 0 0 128
plane 1 0 0 128
plane 0 -1 0 -128
plane 0 1 0 144
plane 0 0 -1 0
plane 0 0 1 128
brush step-1 detail
plane -1 0 0 128
plane 1 0 0 -96
plane 0 -1 0 64
plane 0 1 0 0
plane 0 0 -1 0
plane 0 0 1 16
brush step-2 detail
plane -1 0 0 128
plane 1 0 0 -96
plane 0 -1 0 64
plane 0 1 0 0
plane 0 0 -1 -16
plane 0 0 1 32
brush step-3 detail
plane -1 0 0 128
plane 1 0 0 -96
plane 0 -1 0 64
plane 0 1 0 0
plane 0 0 -1 -32
plane 0 0 1 48
brush trim-beam detail
plane -1 0 0 128
plane 1 0 0 128
plane 0 -1 0 128
plane 0 1 0 128
plane 0 0 -1 -112
plane 0 0 1 120
